# Decisions Log

## Agent Quick Scan

- Use this doc to answer whether something is decided, still open, or explicitly ruled out.
- Stable IDs (`D*`, `O*`) are the shortest reliable way to route from downstream docs back to canon.
- Update this doc first when a product or technical choice changes, then propagate the result to PRD, roadmap, milestones, specs, or agent surfaces.

Tracks what has been decided, what is still open, and what was explicitly ruled out. Updated as product and technical decisions are made.

Decision IDs (`D*`) and open-question IDs (`O*`) are stable identifiers. They may be non-contiguous due to consolidation or removal. Do not renumber existing IDs.

Safari remains a supported no-install entry path. **Sharpened 2026-04-16**: install posture is a real durability upgrade but it is not a single boolean — iPhone durability sits in a three-layer model (ITP 7-day timer, Home Screen carveout, quota-pressure eviction + heuristic persistent mode). Safari applies the 7-day ITP cap on script-writable storage for non-installed sites; installed Home Screen web apps are exempt from that timer but still subject to quota/pressure eviction and WebKit implementation regressions (e.g., the iOS 17.4 "Connection to Indexed Database server lost" bug that continued to surface on iOS 18.0.1). `persisted() === true` is the strongest observable durability state; it is still not a backup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Narrows the validation surface enough to avoid legacy drag while keeping first-run friction low and aligning repeat-use trust with the more app-like install path. Pinning the primary tested posture to the current public iOS line rather than a fixed version number keeps the test bed honest as Apple ships; the iOS 17+ floor matches the Storage API cutover. The earlier "installed = persistent" shorthand has been replaced with the explicit three-layer durability model so that local-save copy, telemetry, and validation stop overpromising native-app-style permanence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 2026-04-11; | D85  | Warm-up and cool-down blocks are mandatory in every session; users can shorten but not remove them. **Sharpened 2026-04-16**: warm-up content must include a brief whole-body ramp, ankle proprioception (single-leg balance), shoulder + trunk activation, and (at 3+ min) sand-specific movement rehearsal. Minimum warm-up dose is ~2 min (compliance fallback only); ~3 min is the defensible default; ~5 min is the opt-in longer version. Prolonged static stretching before play is excluded. Cool-down is 2–3 min and is framed as transition/comfort (see `D105`), not as injury prevention or recovery.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Volleyball warm-up evidence (VolleyVeilig, 11+ Shoulder) supports the *components* but not the claim that a 2–5 min compressed block reproduces the effect size of 10–15 min programmes repeated across a season. Sand-specific evidence (NCAA + pro beach injury profiles) pushes proportionally more time onto shoulder/trunk/movement quality than a generic indoor warm-up would. Post-2015 active-cool-down literature does not support "recovery" or "injury prevention" claims at the 2–3 min dose. Coach review (`O7`) still pending before scaling beyond testers. See `docs/research/warmup-cooldown-minimum-protocols.md`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 2026-04-12; sharpened 2026-04-16                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| D86  | Product is positioned as general training support, not medical advice; no diagnosis, no injury-risk scoring, no return-to-play guidance. Copy, feature naming, marketing, and app-store descriptions all default to the **strictest-credible-interpretation** posture across US / EU / UK / Canada / Australia until target launch markets are chosen. Pain-triggered alternatives are named as lighter / lower-load / lower-impact training choices (not "recovery," "rehab," "therapy," or "injury management"); stop/seek-help copy is fixed generic safety signposting (not interpreted alerts); progression logic is coaching methodology (not prescribed dose or return-to-play protocol).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Avoids accidental medical-device intent under FDA General Wellness guidance (Jan 2026), EU MDCG 2019-11 (June 2025 pain-alleviation counterexample), UK MHRA software guidance, Health Canada SaMD framework, and Australia TGA 2026 guidance. The 2025 FDA WHOOP warning letter confirms that disclaimers do not rescue a function that looks medical in substance, so the wellness posture has to be defended at the feature-behavior and copy layer, not only in the terms of service. Full cross-jurisdiction framing, feature-by-feature mapping, and the avoid-phrase list live in `docs/research/regulatory-boundary-pain-gated-training-apps.md`. | D91  | M001 go/no-go evidence threshold: 5+ testers each complete 2+ sessions within 14 days; kill signal if fewer than 3 of 5 start a second session within 14 days. Read in three layers: (1) kill-floor is a hard no-go screen; (2) go-bar is **permission to keep building and keep testing**, not proof of durable value; (3) the raw count is read in bands — `0-1/5` strong negative, `2/5` ambiguous, `3/5` weak pass of floor (`continue investigating`, not `go`), `4-5/5` the first genuinely encouraging outcome. A bare threshold pass must be upgraded by at least one enrichment signal (unprompted return, second session >48h after the first, or a third session / concrete scheduling commitment) **plus** clean instrumentation: classify every second-session start as `self-initiated` vs `human-prompted` (concierge/founder nudging can manufacture accountability the product does not yet create); capture adherence dimensions (active minutes, full-completion vs mid-flow abandon, full-flow vs narrow-slice engagement) and context logs for completed **and missed** sessions (location, surface, weather, time-of-day, company, blocker); after a tester crosses the 2-in-14 line, ask the Ellis / Superhuman "how disappointed would you be if you could no longer use this?" conviction check. `>50%` review completion is an interpretation aid, not an independent gating metric. **Amended by `D119`:** field-test artifact shifts from v0a to v0b; thresholds and enrichment requirements unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Behavioral retention (repeat sessions) is more reliable than stated interest or waitlists. The kill-floor (`3/5` return) is calibrated against adjacent small-cohort pilot evidence and the self-coached outdoor context. The go-bar is intentionally a sanity-check rather than a PMF threshold because (a) at n=5 the exact 95% binomial CI on `3/5` spans ~15% to ~95%, so a single ratio cannot locate the true retention rate, and (b) novelty-effect literature shows a single return visit inside two weeks can still be curiosity. Concierge / founder nudging is a specific contamination risk for self-coached products: human accountability can manufacture adherence the product itself does not yet create, so self-initiated vs prompted returns are tracked explicitly. Review completion is demoted to interpretation aid because `>50%` on five testers is three reviews — useful for diagnosis, not decisive. See `docs/research/d91-retention-gate-evidence.md`. | D104 | Binary success metric progression is gated by a **minimum 50 scored contacts** in a same-drill-variant + same-success-rule + same-fatigue-context window, combined with a **Bayesian posterior rule**: progress only when `P(p_true_corrected ≥ 0.70                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | x_corrected, n) ≥ 0.80`under a Jeffreys beta-binomial prior. At n = 50 that means **≥ 38 corrected`Good`reps** (boundary ≈ 76% corrected). When personalized bias correction is not yet available, use a **pre-calibration raw proxy of 41 / 50** for general drill families and **42 / 50** for injury-sensitive drill families (serving, jumping, high-load attacking). Fewer than 50 scored contacts carries **no progression signal** (default`hold`). Smaller blocks of 15–20 attempts remain legitimate for coaching feedback, never for the gate. Near-miss gate sessions default to` hold`, not` deload` (hysteresis — see D80/D89). Bias correction uses three layers: a forced, criterion-tied per-rep prompt ("Did this rep meet the drill's observable success rule? If unsure, score Not Good"); a periodic 20-attempt anchor block (athlete + expert/video) whose generosity estimate is shrunk toward a +5 pp generic / +8 pp injury-sensitive prior and updated with an EWMA; and a 10-second borderline-count review triggered only when the session lands inside the boundary zone (raw 36–42 / 50). Coach-, app-, or video-scored progression keeps the 70% latent target and the same 50-attempt posterior rule (without the self-score bias correction).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | The decision-theoretic question at the gate is not "did the athlete hit 70%?" but "is P(true rate ≥ 70%) at least 80%?" A raw 70% observed at the gate leaves that posterior near 0.49 at any sample size (35/50, 70/100). The asymmetric-cost rule `q* = C_FP / (C_FP + C_FN)` gives a 0.80 threshold whenever false progression is ~4× more costly than false hold — defensible for a self-coached, load-aware beach app. At true p = 0.60, the 38/50 corrected gate triggers only ~1.3% of the time; at true p = 0.80, it triggers ~81%, the first operating point where the gate is both safe against false progression and usable for genuinely ready athletes. The sports self-judgment literature is consistently directional, not random: athletes are roughly calibrated on easy/objective tasks (golf putting, easy tennis serve-target) and generous on harder/ambiguous ones (golf chipping 7–8 pp, tennis hard target, dart-distance estimation, collegiate free-throw own-shot prediction, school-age basketball dribbling +5.3/+3.0 cones, volleyball serve judgments of learning). That motivates a directional +5 / +8 pp shrinkage prior rather than treating bias as mean-zero noise. Consumer-product analogues (Dr. Dish 70/100; USGA 54 holes; Arccos minimum-round rules; HomeCourt automated capture) universally either automate measurement or gate on much larger samples; the 50-attempt posterior rule is the smallest statistically honest gate that fits real beach cadence. Still needs in-product validation against tester data per O12. See `docs/research/binary-scoring-progression.md`. |

Progress bands: **+5% to +10% above `baseline3*`* is the default Progress zone; **+10% to +15%** is conditional Progress only when the prior eligible verdict was Hold and `session_load ≤ 1.10 × peak30`; **+15% to +20%** is Hold; **short-term 14-day increase >+20%** is Deload; **single-session >+10% above `peak30`** is a novelty-spike Deload. Hold is the neutral default; Progress must be earned. Minimum-history phases gate the engine: **Conservative bootstrap** (0-2 eligible sessions or <14 days) allows Hold/Deload only; **Emerging baseline** (3-4 eligible sessions over ≥14 days) allows only +5-10% Progress with two clean prior sessions; **Trusted baseline** (≥5 eligible sessions and ≥28 days) unlocks the full precedence table; short-gap re-entry (14-27 days) drops back one phase for 2 sessions; long-gap re-entry (≥28 days) resets to new-user bootstrap. Product-envelope absolute band (not a universal injury threshold): 30-160 AU with >130 AU treated as "high for this product" and never auto-Progressed. A precedence-ordered rule table lives in `docs/specs/m001-adaptation-rules.md`. | D126 | **Interaction-state rule: clickable = hoverable; non-clickable container surface = press-only.** Every clickable primitive (Button variants, `BackButton`, inline chips, icon-buttons, modal close buttons, any `<button>` with an `onClick`) gets a `hover:` state that mirrors its `active:` press token. Container surfaces that are **not** click targets (`HomePrimaryCard` `PRIMARY_CARD_CLASS`, `HomeSecondaryRow` `SECONDARY_ROW_CLASS`, the `Card` component, `PainOverrideCard` wrapping div) keep `active:bg-text-primary/10` for the CSS-`:active`-propagation "whole card darkens while an inner button is pressed" cue, and **do not** get a `hover:` state — a whole-card hover wash implies clickability that does not exist. On mobile, `:active` is the only tactile pseudo-state (no `:hover` without a pointing device), so the same `active:` token that handles desktop press also handles the mobile press-but-not-release window; hover is a desktop-only overlay on top of that. When adding a new clickable control, reuse the variant's existing press token for the hover shade rather than introducing a halfway-strength hover ramp. One-shade-per-control (hover lands on the same token as press) is calmer than a `hover` → `hover+press` ramp on controls the user is deliberately pointing at, and it preserves parity between desktop (hover → click) and mobile (no hover → tap). The warm-preserving `brightness-`* exception (used on `soft` Button, `QuickTagChips` / `RpeSelector` / `IncompleteReasonChips` unselected, and `ToggleChip`) is scoped narrowly to warm-on-warm surfaces so the Japanese-inspired warm identity survives the hover state rather than getting swapped for a cool dark overlay. | D130 | **Founder-use mode. `D91` deferred as a blocking gate for M001 build.** M001 build proceeds on founder personal conviction plus one partner-walkthrough usability pass as a secondary signal, not on `D91` retention data. `D91` stays canonical for the question it answers (would strangers pull the product in), but the founder has now explicitly decided that question can be answered later. Concrete consequences: (1) **the "D91 artifact compromises" in `docs/milestones/m001-solo-session-loop.md` are unblocked as first-class M001 scope** — visible deterministic reasoning surface ("See why this session was chosen"), richer summary copy, session history, and recommendation-first first-run all move back into the M001 product contract, and a named `M002 Weekly Confidence Loop` post-M001 layer (weekly receipt, next-N queue, carry-forward) is reinstated as the post-M001 layer per `docs/milestones/m002-weekly-confidence-loop.md`; (2) the M001 build sequences in tiers (Tier 1 ships the content-and-safety base that the founder and partner can train on weekly; Tier 2 unblocks the deferred surfaces once Tier 1 is stable courtside; Tier 3+ and beyond are revisited only if the founder-use posture still holds at re-eval), with the concrete breakdown in `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-tier1-implementation.md`; (3) tester recruitment is **scoped to founder + partner**, not the 5-tester `D91` cohort — the partner is a usability and wording check, not retention evidence, and partner-sourced data is explicitly labeled non-`D91` in any field notes. Re-evaluation is scheduled for **2026-07-20 (90 days)**, anchored jointly in novelty-effect literature (a single return inside two weeks can still be curiosity per `D91`) and the Volleyball Canada Development Matrix 3-month skill consolidation cycle (three months is the shortest horizon under which "this is actually my training tool, not my new toy" can be claimed against an external rubric). **Early re-eval triggers (any one fires the review ahead of schedule):** (a) fewer than 5 logged sessions in the first 45 days of availability; (b) no app open for 3 or more consecutive weeks during what the founder would consider an active training week (weather-dependent; pain or injury gaps do not trigger); (c) decision to invite any user outside the founder + partner pair; (d) Tier 1a is shipped AND ≥10 founder sessions logged in `docs/research/founder-use-ledger.md` AND the partner walkthrough has returned with no open P0 bugs — in that state, founder-use mode has achieved its purpose and the re-eval MUST fire, and the default re-eval outcome is to resume `D91` preparation for a stranger launch rather than keep iterating founder-only. If any trigger fires or the scheduled date arrives, the review MUST revisit whether to resume `D91` cohort work before any further scope expansion beyond Tier 1/2. **At the re-eval, "continue founder-only" is not a default-available choice.** Extending past the re-eval as founder-only requires a written falsifiable justification (a specific behavioral outcome whose absence would overturn the decision), co-signed by a named non-founder reader (partner or an external reviewer), pasted into `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-adversarial-memo.md`. The default path at the re-eval is option (a) (friends-of-friends cohort) or option (b) (resume `D91` stranger-launch preparation); option (c) (continue founder-only) is opt-in with burden of proof. Distribution to strangers remains a separate blocker downstream of this decision — founder-use mode unblocks build, not release. The operational `D91` protocol (recruitment script, consent, decision memo, per-tester capture sheet) is preserved in `docs/discovery/phase-0-wedge-validation.md` and `docs/research/pre-telemetry-validation-protocol.md` for future activation; nothing about the `D91` numerical bar or enrichment requirements is rescinded, only its position on the critical path for M001 build. | `D91`'s bar is "should strangers pull this in"; the founder's actual decision is "I have conviction for my own weekly use and am willing to pay the build cost to find out if a partner agrees on wording and clarity." These are different questions and `D91` answers the wrong one for the current decision point. Novelty-effect literature (`docs/research/d91-retention-gate-evidence.md`) means even a clean `D91` pass at n=5 cannot distinguish founder conviction from curiosity, so gating the build on a cohort small enough to be dominated by binomial noise spends founder time without buying signal the founder does not already have. The `D91` protocol remains the right gate for a *stranger* launch, which is why it is preserved rather than deleted — just moved off the M001-build critical path. The 90-day horizon is the shortest interval under which the two external anchors available to this product (generic novelty-effect guidance at ~14 days and VDM's "consolidation phase typically requires about 3 months" language) both run to completion; a shorter interval would re-evaluate against a signal that has not yet separated from novelty. Early triggers are written in behavioral terms, not in feelings, because the whole point of the deferral is that founder self-report about excitement is not evidence either direction — only "did I open the app in an active training week" and "did I try to share it" are. The three trigger classes (low cadence, long silence, scope expansion) correspond to the three failure modes founder-use mode actually runs: not using it enough, forgetting it exists, or quietly turning it into stranger-launch before the stranger-launch gate has run. | D131 | **Telemetry and remote session-data collection are deferred for the full `D130` founder-use window; local-first per `P10` is the hard line. Staged unlock thereafter: opt-in JSON export at friends-of-friends, remote telemetry only at `D91` stranger-launch preparation.** During 2026-04-20 → 2026-07-20 (the `D130` window), no network call fires on session end, no counter of app opens or block completions exists anywhere the partner could know about, and no shared "admin view" of partner behavior is built. The existing local `ExecutionLog` and `SessionReview` tables in Dexie remain the only session record; founder self-inspection is mediated through `docs/research/founder-use-ledger.md` (hand-logged, ~30-second append after each session), not through any in-app analytics surface. **Staged unlock:** (1) if the 2026-07-20 re-eval selects option (a) friends-of-friends per the adversarial memo's decision rule, the **first Tier 2 unit** is an opt-in "Share my training data" JSON export button — generates a timestamped local JSON blob the user attaches to email/message manually, no server, no background pings, consent per-action; this preserves `P10` while scaling to n=3–5 testers where manual self-reporting falls apart. (2) Remote telemetry (anything that leaves the device without an explicit per-session user action) is deferred further to the re-opening of `D91` stranger-launch preparation, because `D91`'s numerical thresholds (3/5 return-within-two-weeks, 2/5 log 3+ sessions per `docs/research/d91-retention-gate-evidence.md`) cannot be measured by manual JSON export at cohort sizes of 20+ strangers. **During the D130 window, the no-telemetry posture is a pre-registered constraint of the adversarial memo's Condition 3, not a soft preference** — see `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-adversarial-memo.md` Condition 3. Adding telemetry inside the window requires the same amendment mechanics as weakening a falsification condition (written justification, named non-founder co-signer, pasted into the memo's Amendment Log). If Tier 2 ships an in-app session-history surface that reads local Dexie data (as currently planned), that is NOT telemetry under this decision — it stays on-device, the founder reads their own data, and nothing transmits.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | At n=1 (founder today) telemetry duplicates what Dexie already holds and adds zero signal; the instrumentation gap the red-team flagged (`docs/reviews/2026-04-20-m001-red-team.md`) is a UI gap, not a collection gap, and is bridged by Dexie DevTools + the hand-logged ledger. At n=2 (founder + partner, the entire `D130` window) telemetry is **actively destructive**: Condition 3 of the adversarial memo — partner unprompted-open within 30 days — is the single strongest behavioral signal available in the window, and it only works because the partner has plausible deniability that no one is counting opens. Adding telemetry requires consent disclosure under any reasonable privacy posture; disclosure corrupts the signal because a partner who knows opens are counted may open the app out of social obligation rather than product pull, at which point you are measuring surveillance, not pull. At n=3–5 (friends-of-friends, if selected at re-eval) the math flips because (i) self-report via JSON export scales to roughly 2 cooperating testers before dropping, and (ii) the observer effect is materially dilutable when the tester is "one of five in a cohort" rather than "the founder's one friend" — JSON export is the right middle path because consent is visible and per-action, which `P10` requires. At n≥20 (`D91` stranger launch) telemetry becomes a hard requirement: the numerical thresholds are unmeasurable without it, and observer effect is fully diluted. The staged approach (none → opt-in export → remote) preserves `P10` as a live doctrine through the entire validation arc rather than retracting it the moment external signal is needed. Consistent with `P10`, `P9`, `D91`, `D130`, and Condition 3 of `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-adversarial-memo.md`. | D135 | **Walkthrough-equivalence is source-validity gated, not script gated; founder content-gap evidence is first-class (2026-04-28).** Authorizes the policy clarification recorded in `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-adversarial-memo.md` Amendment Log 2026-04-28 entry. **Policy.** (1) Any non-founder use of the production build that produces structural task-class observations counts as walkthrough-equivalent, regardless of whether the use was scripted; sources include voice memos, written notes, chat dumps, screen recordings, and Dexie exports paired with debrief commentary. The test is source-validity (real session, real build, real observation), not format. (2) Founder-side evidence is first-class on triggers that name founder evidence; founder-use ledger rows remain authoritative per-session and the founder's chat / voice-memo content-gap reports tied to real use sessions count alongside them, not as a degraded second tier — `D130` mode authorizes founder-use *as* product evaluation, so founder experience is load-bearing evidence, not procedural input. (3) **Boundary.** Founder content-gap reports ("on session X I tried Y and couldn't find Z") are first-class evidence; founder feature wishes ("I think we should add a focus picker") are *input*, not evidence — they count when there is also a real underlying friction, not by themselves. **Falsification-condition impact:** none. The three `D130` falsification conditions in `docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-adversarial-memo.md` (Condition 1: ≥40% solo share + ≥3 set-focused sessions; Condition 2: zero outside-app planning; Condition 3: partner unprompted open within 30 days) never used "scripted" anywhere and are unaffected. The authoring-budget cap, the channel-mix list (channels (a)–(e) per the 2026-04-24 expansion), and the 2026-07-20 default-against-inertia decision rule are also untouched. **Co-signer requirement:** waived per the adversarial memo's amendment rule (no falsification condition is weakened, no threshold shifted, no decision rule changed; the rule binds only on weakening edits). **Trigger-state consequences (recorded for routing, not new state):** Tier 1c trigger (`docs/plans/2026-04-20-m001-tier1-implementation.md` §"Tier 1c trigger") clause 2 is **fired** by Seb's 2026-04-27 cca2 voice memo + 2026-04-28 build-17 voice memo (two independent ≥P1 partner hits naming a missing focus toggle: *"today I want to do 30 minutes of serving — let me select that"* and the build-17 landing-page / *"option to choose a new difficulty setting"* consistent ask); skill-level-mutability sibling trigger (same plan §"Skill-level mutability — separate surface, separate trigger") "≥P1 partner walkthrough flag specifically about skill-level inflexibility" clause is **fired** by the same two memos (Seb's *"let me change my skill set level day-to-day"* in cca2 + the build-17 *"option to choose a new difficulty setting"* land directly on that clause). `D133`'s 2026-04-26 founder-chat-dump-fired `P2-3` trigger is the canonical precedent for the same shape — a chat-delivered content-gap report fired a Tier 1b trigger and led directly to the `/run/check` Drill Check ship — and is preserved as illustration of policy in action. The Tier 1b Framing C re-trigger count (1 of ≥2 hits per `docs/plans/2026-04-26-pair-rep-capture-tier1b.md` §"Re-trigger condition for Framing C") is **not** advanced by this row — that count is about specifically the optional-Good/Total card feeling fake post-`D133`, a different evidence type than the focus-picker / skill-level-mutability asks above. **Implementation under sequencing option A (chosen 2026-04-28):** the policy clarification + trigger-state updates land as a docs ship under this row; Tier 1c implementation (`sessionFocus: 'pass' \| 'serve' \| 'set'` field on `SessionDraft.context`, dynamic `slot.skillTags` override in `pickForSlot` AND `findSwapAlternatives`, draft-screen Swap-Focus button per `P11`) and the skill-level-mutability surface (Settings "Adjust today's level" affordance OR draft-screen one-tap level up/down with `skillLevelOverride?: 'beginner' \| 'intermediate' \| 'advanced'` per the Tier 1 plan §"Skill-level mutability" architectural-shape note) are each their own future ship. The Tier 1 plan §"Architectural prerequisites" remains the binding artifact for Tier 1c implementation; the founder retains the choice to bundle or sequence Tier 1c and skill-level-mutability when those ships are scheduled. | Two compounding observations forced the policy clarification. First, the "scripted walkthrough" qualifier in the Tier 1c trigger evidence block was the founder's own conservative gloss appended to the trigger reading, not part of the original 2026-04-20 trigger language — the original clause says "Partner walkthrough ledger contains a ≥P1 flag" which Seb's voice memos satisfy literally (he ran the production build courtside, produced structural Task-B-class observations, and the founder transcribed them into the repo). Continuing to read "scripted" into the trigger meant the founder was holding a shifting bar against the partner-side evidence the trigger was designed to capture. Second, founder-side evidence was being implicitly downweighted in the same pattern: ledger rows counted toward Condition 1 and the ≥8 founder-session clause of the Tier 1c trigger, but founder-chat-delivered content-gap reports (e.g., the 2026-04-21 "we don't get to pick focuses" and the 2026-04-26 "fake count" reports that fired `D133`'s `P2-3`) were sometimes treated as procedural input rather than first-class evidence — even though `D130` mode is *defined* as founder-use being the evaluation channel. Recognizing both halves explicitly closes the gap between what the founder (and Seb) are actually contributing as evidence and what the triggers register as evidence. The boundary clause exists because the adversarial memo's central concern is that "founder-use mode has no adversary in the room by default" — under a too-broad reading where any founder chat counts as evidence, the founder can fire any trigger by saying anything; the boundary preserves the adversary by distinguishing observed friction (which the trigger structure is designed to capture and act on) from stated wishes (which are inputs to founder reasoning, not signals the trigger structure should treat as evidence). This is consistent with the founder-use ledger's existing schema (rows are sessions with notes about what happened, not feature wishlists). The policy is a *clarification* of how to read existing triggers under `D130`, not a relaxation — same falsification conditions, same authoring-budget cap, same channel-mix list, same 2026-07-20 default-against-inertia decision rule. The fact that two triggers fire under the cleared reading is exactly the asymmetric-against-inertia outcome the adversarial memo was designed to produce when evidence is real: the conservatism that was suppressing the trigger fire was inertia, not adversarial discipline. Consistent with `D130` (founder-use mode + early triggers), `D131` (no telemetry implied — this policy reads existing chat / voice memos, does not add an in-app analytics surface), `D133` (canonical precedent for chat-dump-fires-trigger), `D134` (precedent for bounded D130 founder-use exception with falsification gate), `O5` (M001 evidence threshold at 2026-07-20 re-eval is unchanged), and the adversarial memo §"Recognized behavioral-evidence channels" expanded 2026-04-24 (channel (e) founder chat / voice-memo feedback was already recognized as a behavioral-evidence channel; this policy clarifies that channel (e) content-gap reports count as first-class trigger evidence, not just framing input). | 2026-04-28 |

| D142 | **B1 — T9 scoring-overlay-grammar modeling stance: sibling variants on a parent drill, with composable overlay metadata (2026-05-08).** Settles the modeling stance for the captured BAB scoring-overlay grammar (T9: nine composable rule kinds plus asymmetric-scoring axis) before any future `scoringRules` schema work commits to a shape. Volleycraft will model rule-restriction and rule-augmentation overlays as **sibling variants on a parent drill, with composable overlay metadata**, so the Mini Games to 7 family across Plans 5/8/12/15/19 lands as one parent drill identity with sibling overlay variants rather than four separate top-level records. Restriction and augmentation overlays must compose **symmetrically** on the same record per the synthesis's explicit constraint. Overlay metadata is descriptive at authoring time (informs courtside copy and diagnostic classification) rather than runtime-constraint-engine-driving in the first post-`D101` pass. **Authorization boundary.** No `scoringRules` schema, no Dexie field, no `successMetric` extension, no UI surface, and no diagnostic classifier change is authorized by this decision. The asymmetric-scoring axis (Plan 20 reset-on-miss / per-team rules) is **deferred indefinitely** at this stance — single source case in BAB; revisit requires a second source case. **Rejected alternatives.** Separate drill records per overlay (BAB's source pattern; consumes authoring-budget cap on near-duplicates and forces diagnostic spine to discover sibling identity by name-matching after the fact); runtime constraint toggles in the first pass (pushes constraint composition into the hot courtside path against `D137` / `D141` calm-courtside posture); supporting only restriction (forces authoring back into duplicate-record territory for augmentation, breaking the synthesis's symmetry constraint); mixing all three approaches across the catalog (synthesis warns this creates diagnostic noise). **Revisit triggers.** Re-open the stance when `D101` unlocks 3+ player support and the first post-`D101` pressure-drill candidate cannot be expressed cleanly as a sibling variant; when an Around-the-World-Serve-class non-`D101`-gated source-priority drill clears the diagnostics activation pipeline and forces an overlay schema decision; when a second source case for asymmetric scoring surfaces; or when a future authoring pass discovers two real catalog rows where the sibling-variant stance forces measurable diagnostic-noise overhead. Arguments against adding it to v0b: `D23` keeps first-pass review lightweight, and `sessionRpe` on the grouped `D96` scale plus `goodPassRate` plus `incompleteReason` already carry most of the signal. Arguments for adding it later: "how did the session fit" is a cleaner human framing than "effort 0–10 plus pass rate," it strengthens the **review payoff**, and it gives the app better language for a forward-looking next-step explanation. A reason bucket on "too hard" (paces too tough / workout too long / not feeling 100%) would also surface context that is otherwise buried. Not v0b scope; validate with `D91` tester read-outs. Paired with `O12`, `O15`, and `D91`. ## Ruled out (for now)


| Item                                                                                                    | Reason                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Social/community feed                                                                                   | Not core to training workflow; distraction risk                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Video analytics / computer vision                                                                       | Too complex for MVP; manual logging is sufficient                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Open-ended AI chat as primary UX                                                                        | Structured objects and workflows are the product stance                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| AI-generated training plans or progression logic                                                        | High risk of hallucinated load plans, omissions, and automation bias; strictly deterministic generation only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Indoor volleyball support                                                                               | Beach-specific focus is a feature, not a limitation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Monetization in v1                                                                                      | Validate the loop first; monetization design captured in research                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Community challenges                                                                                    | v1.5+ at earliest; need proven single-user loop first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| CRDTs or real-time collaborative editing in Phase 1                                                     | No validated need for concurrent editing; async coach review is sufficient and avoids premature complexity                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Server-authoritative data model                                                                         | Conflicts with the local-first product principle; the device is the source of truth                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ACWR-based risk scoring or "danger zone" messaging                                                      | Evidence is contested (statistical artifacts, no causal proof, method-sensitive results); shipping it risks false authority and overconfident safety claims. Spike avoidance uses conservative heuristics instead.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Deep recovery analytics (HRV, wearable integrations)                                                    | Unclear added value for M001's first wedge; increases complexity without validated need                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Return-to-play guidance for specific injuries                                                           | Quickly becomes clinical/medical advice; should be clinician-led, not app-driven                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Centralized coach marketplace / platform-sourced coach network (Future / on-demand expert access model) | Requires platform-led coach recruiting, matching, QA, and utilization management — a software-enabled services business, not a lightweight extension. Public evidence (Future at $199/month) and U.S. BLS wage medians (~$46k/year for fitness trainers and coaches/scouts) make that line economically workable only when dedicated human coaching is the whole product. A niche self-coached sport with no existing coach network is structurally the wrong context for this model. `D106` freezes BYOC-lite as the shape instead. Revisitable only on strong post-clipboard pull evidence against the four `D108` metrics. See `docs/research/coach-facing-business-models.md`. |
| Direct-to-coach SaaS as a standalone motion (coach seat SKU before athlete-side value is proven)        | Coach buyer is fragmented and often self-employed (IBISWorld); winners in the coach-SaaS category prices gently, add payments/branding/discovery, or sell into organizations. A product without existing coach distribution should not assume direct-to-coach SaaS will rescue growth. `D107` reserves monetization to the athlete side until repeated weekly coach usage appears. See `docs/research/coach-facing-business-models.md`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |


## For agents

- **Authoritative for**: decision status (decided, open, ruled out). This is the single place to check what has been decided.
- **Edit when**: a product or technical decision is made, resolved, or explicitly ruled out.
- **Belongs elsewhere**: principles and strategic stance (`vision.md`), product scope (`prd-foundation.md`), phase sequencing (`roadmap.md`).
- **Outranked by**: `vision.md` only.
- **Key patterns**: decision IDs (`D`*) and open-question IDs (`O`*) are stable, non-contiguous identifiers. Other docs cross-reference them in parentheses, e.g., `(D60)`. When adding a new decision, use the next unused number. When removing one, do not renumber existing IDs.
